people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: “Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families. You shall count every male from a month old and upward.”
translations.bsb: “Number the Levites by their families and clans. You are to count every male a month old or more.”
translations.kjv: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number
translations.asv: Number the children of Levi by their fathers' houses, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
